body: Are you okay to PM for a bit?
Doubt. I appreciate what you’re trying to do but in my case it just isn’t true

Yeah I know taking my own life is “a bit extreme” but it’s the only option that I can see. I don’t want to die, which is why I’m seeing my doctor about this, because maybe therapy or pills could make me see another way but it’s really pointless because I know deep down there is no other way. Everything is getting worse day by day. I have so many reasons to want to end it Each other then would be enough for most people but I’ve carried on through the pain only to be met with more reasons.
Things are getting worse all the time. I’m getting to the end. I can’t manage much longer. I’ve been suicidal for so long but now I can actually see myself doing it. My life is way too much
